method: Actual bundled viewer, selected delivered models/LODs and clips×7 deterministic times (defaults: all16 models/all31clips), plus interrupted transition poses. Compare every decoded vertex using optimized Y-row evaluator against Three.SkinnedMesh.getVertexPosition+matrixWorld. Optional --dense-floor advances each actual displayed clip at the recorded30/60/120Hz, checking reference full-mesh floor, active sole anchors and descriptive authored hand supports. GPU draws suppressed; rendering performance is tested separately.
